title: Ox Passion Strawberry Melon Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Strawberry Melon blends the soft, juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the light, refreshing taste of Melon. The smooth, sun-kissed berry flavour unfolds on the inhale, while the delicate, subtly honeyed melon adds a mellow sweetness and cooling sensation on the exhale, making for a mellow and well-balanced fruit vape. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, ensuring a smooth throat hit and a consistently full-bodied flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it delivers rapid nicotine absorption for a satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
